comparison.objective: Extract one locked connector terminal; record packages a PCB in a bag and crate.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed-tab blade release and coordinated wire/tool withdrawal versus bimanual bag holding, board insertion, and placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires the selected terminal out with housing, crimp, and neighbors intact; record requires the board fully bagged and the released bag resting in the crate. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The tested contact mechanism and completed state are materially different.
